strings.name: Michael Dell
strings.summary: Dell assembled and sold computers while attending the University of Texas, then left to build a direct-sales, build-to-order business. He led privatization, the EMC acquisition and a return to public markets, expanding into enterprise computing. In 2010 he settled SEC disclosure charges with a civil penalty. He also established a foundation with his wife.
